children: Schouw & Co. Capital Markets Day 2026
Schouw & Co. is pleased to invite investors, analysts and media representatives to the company’s Capital Markets Day on Thursday 8 October 2026 at 9.30 CEST.
The Capital Markets Day will include presentations by Schouw & Co. representatives, as well as the CEOs of GPV, HydraSpecma, and the newly acquired portfolio business Spectre.
The event will provide deeper insights into:
Schouw & Co.’s ambitions towards 2030 and beyond
The businesses’ exposure to structural growth drivers, global megatrends, and their role in the future development of Schouw & Co.’s portfolio
Schouw & Co.’s approach to capital allocation and long-term value creation.
Selected products and applications from GPV, HydraSpecma, and Spectre will also be on display during the day.
Programme and details

The Capital Markets Day will take place on Thursday 8 October 2026 from 9.30-14.00 CEST at Admiral Hotel, Toldbodgade 24-28, 1253 Copenhagen. The programme will be followed by lunch and networking from 13.00.
A detailed agenda will be published on Schouw & Co.’s website closer to the event date.

About Schouw & Co.

Founded in 1878, Schouw & Co. is one of Denmark’s largest industrial conglomerates. In 2025, the Group generated revenue of DKK 34.1 billion and EBITDA of DKK 2.9 billion. Schouw & Co. owns leading industrial businesses, with a diversified portfolio comprising BioMar, GPV, HydraSpecma, Borg Automotive, Fibertex Personal Care, Fibertex Nonwovens, and Spectre. Through active, long-term ownership and a long investment horizon, Schouw & Co. transforms its portfolio companies and supports value creation.
